name: Fighting position with overhead cover
description: Sandbagged two-man fighting position with overhead cover, 3.2 x 3.0 m: sandbag walls to 1.3 m on the front and flanks, a 0.5 m firing slit under a roof of 4x4 posts, 2x8 stringers, plywood and two courses of sandbags; entered from the open rear.
